document.about: Cree Lighting CR4T downlight spec sheet, Canada (Word-made, 3 pages). Its field angle sets the degree sign as a small raised letter o after the number.

notes: 2026-11-25 (#209): the beam angle sets its degree as a raised `o` after two figures and a tilde, `~ 95o`. A raised `o` after one or two figures may be an ordinal's ending, and was kept as one; the field angle's `~ 145°`, three figures, was read as a degree.
